PRIMARY saves52,289B/op and82objects/op; it is still slower, so this is bounded viability rather than a speedup claim. Earlier failed measurements remain retained. [Current decision](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5111#issuecomment-6193413716); [canonical execution state](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6157916554).

The scan-removal/compact-metadata changes now include focused verified admission-lineage and queued-remap lifetime repairs. Actual Mongo race and real owned PRIMARY activation pass. Remaining platform/caller and retention/format/recovery CI failures are being repaired in coherent groups. The unchanged vacuum fixture confirms three full copies of one297-page DATA base (594 redundant pages). The selected repair copies the common base once and uses existing COW for distinct versions, preserving every recovery root and the40% shrink target. The original nonlast-owner guard also proves one avoidable allocation; its shared scalar-release fix is active. Complete CI logs reject a speculative deferred-guard rewrite for the two completion-flag failures. Do not weaken durability, reclamation, shrink or allocation assertions to finish. PR#5127 remains draft atb3c7; exact-head CI and independent Sol review remain open. No new speculative allocation campaign or one-failure push loop.

[Native#4878 integration is active provisionally](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4878#issuecomment-6195392536) on the frozen43 shared contract. It retains the original visible-install admission commit, durable fence/turn release and actual physical Finish with SAME transaction/allocator/ledger; its first check pauses real Finish while a newer durable writer completes. Q32RED and publicACK0 are preserved; no fourth ordinary-only diagnostic or duplicate publisher. Final#4879 and durability-matched Dgraph outcome gates remain required. Allocation PRs#5134/#5135 are merged; #5130 finite integration is closed. The separate pre-sprint Batch.Write45,144→21,314ns,152,663→31,943B,281→127allocations anchor is not current native/final acceptance. [Scorecard](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/4871#issuecomment-6183964913). Root retains strategic/merge ownership; all implementation remains Sol6.1. Released disposable artifacts are deleted as consumers finish, while source/evidence stay protected.

## Active execution and accepted architecture repair — 2026-10-13

User has authorized graph repair and execution through validation/merge, with GPT-6.1 Sol-only children and released-data cleanup. Coordinator and final acceptance owner: `/root`. This block supersedes older execution/host/owner snapshots below; their evidence and unchanged specifications remain history. Parent is incomplete.

**Accepted decision:** Complete one production configuration with cheap immutable snapshots, atomic grouped writes, durability-correct ACKs and bounded logical plus physical reclamation. The ordinary prerequisite and native integration are structural work; wrapper/allocation discounts cannot substitute for their complete ownership/progress proof. Consume landed C3-read #5076 / PR #5080 and harness #5118 / PR #5126. Preserve PR #5127 and useful checkpoint source; keep it draft until its entire implementation packet passes. Do not reopen accepted read qualification or adopt foreign R1/C4 work.

The production contract is one immutable published cut, producer-maintained ordered state, and the existing DB publication/retirement authority. Readers retain a complete physical cut independently of application timestamps; grouped commands publish atomically. Ordinary producers supply the exact DATA/PRIMARY/resource closure before maintenance starts. Native pruning reuses the SAME allocator/coordinator/DurableRootTransaction and existing physical-identity registry; no second WAL, publisher, reclaim registry or capture-time history-sized index. Floor eligibility precedes effects, floor persistence precedes deletion, and all versions above the floor plus the required anchor/tombstone ordering remain correct.

Command-WAL DURABLE means the dependency-complete stable WAL prefix plus memory publication, without a full checkpoint. RELAXED retains the current kernel-drained command WAL plus memory publication, without fsync; a pure memtable-only ACK belongs to a separately qualified NoWALFast contract. Persistent value-log reachability and old-reader ownership remain authoritative. Accepted/once-ACK and finite Finish survive later errors without reapplication. Charge actual capacity, overlap, descriptors, cleanup controls and all preparation/publication/retirement work before effects; refund only at synchronized actual last-owner cleanup. Capped refusal on growing ordinary state is not bounded eventual progress.

## Retained specification and historical checkpoints

## Goal

Make TreeDB's external-timestamp MVCC an efficient substrate for Dgraph posting reads and sustained updates. Reuse the fastest existing source-selection, ordered-seek, batch and ownership paths before building new machinery. Done means the admitted changes have their own correctness/performance proofs, the matched TreeDB/Badger gap narrows under a frozen measurement policy, and obsolete version history is reclaimed with bounded maintenance and foreground disruption.
